title: The Little Library of Lost Things
author: Hamidreza Rostami
short_description: A magical library where lost items tell their stories.
long_description: At the end of Maple Street stands the Little Library of Lost Things, run by the kind Ms. Willow. She has a special gift—she can hear the stories of lost things. Children come to her library to find their missing treasures, and Ms. Willow tells them the adventures their items have been on. When Sam loses his favorite toy car, Ms. Willow helps him find it and shares its journey. When Emily loses her best friend who moved away, Ms. Willow gives her a stone from the Friendship Box to help her stay connected. The library becomes a place where lost things are found, stories are told, and hearts are healed. A heartwarming story about empathy, connection, and the magic of stories.
